title: Qwen3-VL end-to-end TensorRT vision integration functional harness

integration_boundary.visual_adapter: nn.Module adapter assigned to model.model.visual at runtime
integration_boundary.decoder_path: unchanged Qwen3VLModel language_model and Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration lm_head
integration_boundary.integration_check: one PyTorch visual pass versus one TensorRT visual pass before generation

workload.image_description: deterministic white background with a filled red square at [112,112,335,335]
workload.eos_masking: EOS is masked before argmax for decode steps 1 through 14; step 15 may emit EOS

timing.first_token_latency: CUDA event duration around the complete prefill forward after preprocessing
timing.total_latency: CUDA event duration from immediately before prefill through the final fixed-token decode call
timing.event_synchronization: synchronize before timing start, after prefill event pair, and after total event

correctness.first_token_logits_comparison: max absolute error, mean absolute error, cosine similarity, and top-1 agreement against baseline trial 1 for cross-backend integration evidence

memory.note: allocator snapshots, not TensorRT total-process GPU memory or profiler DRAM counters

acceptance.conclusion: establish functional integration harness and record bounded evidence only
